crossRefs.note: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, Yahweh,
Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean…
But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ…
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

parallels.note: Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
